entry.line: A practical growth partnership for The Her.

s1.headline: HELPING MORE WOMEN BUILD STRONGER BUSINESSES.
s1.subheadline: The Her already supports the woman behind the business. Together, we can strengthen the digital system around her.
s1.body: This proposal brings The Her’s coaching and business insight together with hands-on expertise in digital growth, conversion, analytics and automation — giving each client the support her business actually needs.

s2.headline: One ambition can lead to many kinds of business.
s2.subheadline: A useful solution starts with the reality of each client.
s2.body: Some clients are turning an Instagram page into a brand. Others need a better shop, a clearer offer, or a more reliable way to grow sales. Their goals may overlap, but their priorities, customers and constraints are different.

mosaic.title: Measurement & Growth
mosaic.line: Clear data · better decisions · steady improvement

s3.headline: Different businesses need different kinds of support.
s3.subheadline: The first task is to find the real constraint.
s3.body: A sales problem is not always a traffic problem. The gap may be in the offer, the website, follow-up, measurement or day-to-day operations. I identify that gap first, then recommend only the work that can make a meaningful difference.

s4.headline: The solution should fit the business — not the other way around.
s4.subheadline: No default package, and no list of services for its own sake.
s4.body: We begin with the goal, the customer journey and the available evidence. Only then do we decide whether the right next step is marketing, a stronger experience, better measurement, automation, or a combination of them.

s5.headline: The Her knows the founder. I strengthen the system around her business.
s5.subheadline: Business coaching and digital execution, working in the same direction.
s5.body: The Her brings context, trust and a deep understanding of each woman’s goals. I add strategy and execution across acquisition, conversion, analytics, websites and automation. The result is more joined-up support, without The Her having to build a full digital team.

s6.headline: DATA + MARKETING + EXPERIENCE + AI
s6.subheadline: Better results come from making the parts work together.
s6.body: Each capability is useful on its own. The greater value comes from connecting them around one commercial goal, with clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

s7.headline: “We need more sales.”
s7.subheadline: Before buying more traffic, we find out where potential sales are being lost.
s7.body: The initial request tells us the goal, not necessarily the cause. I review the full journey from first visit to purchase and follow-up, then focus effort on the point with the greatest impact.

diagnostic.title: Traffic
diagnostic.question: Are the right people arriving?
diagnostic.answer: We compare channel quality, audience fit and intent. More visitors only help when they include the people the offer is designed for.

diagnostic.title: Offer
diagnostic.question: Is the value clear and relevant?
diagnostic.answer: We test whether the value, difference and next step are clear within the first moments of seeing the offer.

diagnostic.title: Trust
diagnostic.question: Is there enough confidence to act?
diagnostic.answer: We review proof, transparency and the visual experience to understand what may be making a potential buyer hesitate.

diagnostic.title: Experience
diagnostic.question: Is the journey simple and persuasive?
diagnostic.answer: We follow the real mobile and desktop journey, looking for confusing choices, slow pages and unnecessary steps.

diagnostic.title: Conversion
diagnostic.question: Where do people stop?
diagnostic.answer: We use funnel data to locate the main drop-off, then improve that specific page, form, checkout or booking step.

diagnostic.title: Follow-up
diagnostic.question: What happens after interest?
diagnostic.answer: We map what happens after someone shows interest and improve CRM, nurturing and retargeting so valuable leads are not forgotten.

diagnostic.title: Data
diagnostic.question: Can we see what is actually working?
diagnostic.answer: We set up the events, campaign naming and dashboards needed to tell which activity is contributing to sales.

s7.keyLine: DIAGNOSE FIRST. BUILD WHAT THE BUSINESS NEEDS.

cases.headline: “People visit our store, but too few buy.”
cases.subheadline: More traffic is useful only after the current journey works.
cases.diagnosis: The main opportunity may be in offer clarity, trust, product pages, checkout or follow-up — rather than acquisition.
cases.response: Review the funnel, identify the largest drop-off, improve the relevant experience and put reliable conversion tracking in place.
cases.keyLine: Before paying for more visits, get more value from the visits you already have.

cases.headline: “Our business has outgrown our website.”
cases.subheadline: The digital experience should match the quality of the business.
cases.diagnosis: The gap may involve positioning, content structure, mobile UX, performance and measurement — not simply visual design.
cases.response: Define the website’s role, simplify the customer journey, redesign and build the experience, then connect it to measurable goals.
cases.keyLine: A good website should support the business, not just describe it.

cases.headline: “Growth is creating too much manual work.”
cases.subheadline: Repeated admin should not consume the team’s best time.
cases.diagnosis: Lead handling, reporting, CRM updates and routine communication may be creating avoidable delays and errors.
cases.response: Map the workflow, prioritise the highest-value automation, connect the necessary tools and use AI only where it is dependable and useful.
cases.keyLine: Automation should make the team more capable, not make the business harder to run.

s10.headline: Add digital capability when The Her or its clients need it.

s10.body: I can work on The Her’s own growth, join selected client engagements, or deliver quietly behind the scenes. In every model, responsibilities stay clear and The Her remains in control of the client relationship.
